# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(bacon)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(parallel)
  library(doParallel)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION", "data")
reference_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "ref_files")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results", "linear_model")
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "code", "R")

source(file.path(code_dir, "parallel_functions.R"))
```

# Define Functions

## Load Data

```{r func_load}
# prefix is "" for the primary analysis and "Smoking_Adjusted_" for the
# smoking-adjusted sensitivity analysis (both written by 02a)
get_stat_data <- function(label, prefix = "") {
  save_name <- paste0(prefix, "EAP_stats.csv")

  stats_df <- read.csv(file.path(save_dir, save_name))

  # Keep the annotation columns, plus the statistics for `label`.
  label_columns <- c("estimate", "std_error", "tvalue", "pvalue", "zvalue", "fdr")
  columns <- colnames(stats_df)
  meta_columns <- columns[
    !grepl(paste0("^(", paste(label_columns, collapse = "|"), ")"), columns)
  ]
  select_columns <- c(meta_columns, paste(label_columns, label, sep = "_"))

  stats_df <- stats_df[, select_columns]
  colnames(stats_df) <- c(meta_columns, label_columns)

  stats_df
}

get_dnam_data <- function() {
  pheno_df <- read.csv(file.path(save_dir, "Phenotypes.csv"))
  dnam_data <- readRDS(
    file.path(hrs_dir, "batch_corrected", "HRS_White_NHispanic_PCA.RDS")
  )
  dnam_data <- dnam_data[
    , dnam_data$SubjectID_Submitter %in% pheno_df$SubjectID_Submitter
  ]

  dnam_data
}
```

## Get IQR

```{r func_iqr}
get_iqr <- function(dnam_data) {
  beta_vals <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam

  iqr_df <- data.frame(
    CpG = row.names(beta_vals),
    IQR = unname(apply(beta_vals * 100, MARGIN = 1, stats::IQR))
  )

  iqr_df
}

add_iqr_fdr <- function(stats_df, min_iqr = 2) {
  stats_df$fdr_exclude_iqr_lt2 <- NA
  stats_df$fdr_exclude_iqr_lt2_bacon <- NA

  targets <- stats_df$IQR >= min_iqr

  stats_df$fdr_exclude_iqr_lt2[targets] <- stats::p.adjust(
    stats_df$pvalue[targets], method = "fdr"
  )
  stats_df$fdr_exclude_iqr_lt2_bacon[targets] <- stats::p.adjust(
    stats_df$pvalue_bacon[targets], method = "fdr"
  )

  stats_df
}
```

## Bacon Correction

```{r func_bacon}
bacon_parameter_names <- c(
  "alpha", "beta", "lambda1", "lambda2", "tau1", "tau2", "gamma1", "gamma2"
)

# Call fun(data, alpha = ..., ..., gamma2 = ...) with the BACON prior
# parameters taken from `params` (a list or a one-row data frame).
call_with_bacon_params <- function(fun, data, params) {
  do.call(fun, c(list(data), as.list(params)[bacon_parameter_names]))
}

build_bacon_priors <- function(
    alpha, beta, lambda1, lambda2, tau1, tau2, gamma1, gamma2
) {
  list(
    sigma = list(alpha = alpha, beta = beta),
    mu = list(lambda = c(lambda1, lambda2, -lambda2), tau = c(tau1, tau2, tau2)),
    epsilon = list(gamma = c(gamma1, gamma2, gamma2))
  )
}

fit_bacon <- function(estimate, std_error, priors, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  bacon::bacon(
    teststatistics = NULL,
    effectsizes = estimate,
    standarderrors = std_error,
    na.exclude = TRUE,
    priors = priors
  )
}

# Genomic inflation factor of the z-values implied by estimate / std_error.
get_inflation <- function(estimate, std_error, df) {
  tvalue <- estimate / std_error
  zvalue <- stats::qnorm(stats::pt(tvalue, df))
  chisq <- zvalue^2

  stats::median(chisq, na.rm = TRUE) / stats::qchisq(0.5, 1)
}

run_bacon_correction <- function(
    data,
    alpha = 1.28,
    beta = 0.36,
    lambda1 = 0,
    lambda2 = 3,
    tau1 = 1000,
    tau2 = 100,
    gamma1 = 99,
    gamma2 = 0.5
) {
  priors <- build_bacon_priors(
    alpha, beta, lambda1, lambda2, tau1, tau2, gamma1, gamma2
  )

  bc <- fit_bacon(data$estimate, data$std_error, priors, seed = 23)
  data_bacon <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      estimate_bacon = bacon::es(bc),
      std_error_bacon = bacon::se(bc),
      pvalue_bacon = bacon::pval(bc)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fdr_bacon = stats::p.adjust(.data$pvalue_bacon, method = "fdr")
    )

  # Refit on the corrected values to check the remaining inflation and bias.
  bc2 <- fit_bacon(
    data_bacon$estimate_bacon, data_bacon$std_error_bacon, priors, seed = 42
  )

  inflation_effect <- c(
    inflation_original = get_inflation(data$estimate, data$std_error, data$df),
    inflation_bacon = as.numeric(bacon::inflation(bc)),
    bias_bacon = as.numeric(bacon::bias(bc)),
    inflation_correction = get_inflation(
      data_bacon$estimate_bacon, data_bacon$std_error_bacon, data$df
    ),
    inflation_bacon_correction = as.numeric(bacon::inflation(bc2)),
    bias_bacon_correction = as.numeric(bacon::bias(bc2))
  )

  list(data = data_bacon, inflation_effect = inflation_effect)
}

# One row: the prior parameters and the inflation and bias left after correction.
evaluate_bacon_correction <- function(data, params) {
  inflation_effect <- call_with_bacon_params(
    run_bacon_correction, data, params
  )$inflation_effect

  data.frame(
    as.list(params)[bacon_parameter_names],
    inflation = inflation_effect[["inflation_correction"]],
    inflation_bacon = inflation_effect[["inflation_bacon_correction"]],
    bias_bacon = inflation_effect[["bias_bacon_correction"]]
  )
}
```

## Iterative Bacon

```{r func_iter}
get_random_parameters <- function(count = 100, seed = 12) {
  set.seed(seed)
  data.frame(
    step = 1:count,
    alpha = round(runif(count, min = 0.5, max = 2), digits = 3),
    beta = round(runif(count, min = 0.1, max = 1), digits = 3),
    lambda1 = round(runif(count, min = -1, max = 1), digits = 3),
    lambda2 = round(runif(count, min = 1, max = 4), digits = 3),
    tau1 = round(10**runif(count, min = 2, max = 4), digits = 1),
    tau2 = runif(count, min = 0.02, max = 0.5),
    gamma1 = round(runif(count, min = 80, max = 99), digits = 1),
    gamma2 = runif(count, min = 0.1, max = 0.9)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      tau2 = round(.data$tau1 * .data$tau2, digits = 1),
      gamma2 = round((100 - .data$gamma1) * .data$gamma2, digits = 3)
    )
}

run_bacon_iter <- function(data, random_df) {
  parallel_res <- start_parallel(TRUE, 16)
  do_parallel <- parallel_res$parallel
  cluster <- parallel_res$cluster

  res_df <- plyr::adply(
    .data = random_df,
    .margins = 1,
    .fun = function(row) {
      evaluate_bacon_correction(data, row)
    }, .parallel = do_parallel
  )

  stop_parallel(do_parallel, cluster)

  res_df
}
```

## Bacon Wrapper

```{r func_bacon_wrapper}
bacon_analyze <- function(data) {
  random_df <- get_random_parameters(count = 1024, seed = 24)
  iter_df <- run_bacon_iter(data, random_df)
  iter_df <- iter_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      score1 = abs(1 - .data$inflation_bacon),
      score2 = abs(.data$bias_bacon),
      score = pmax(.data$score1, .data$score2)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(.data$score)

  # Rerun the correction with the best-scoring parameters.
  res <- call_with_bacon_params(run_bacon_correction, data, iter_df[1, ])
  inflation_effect <- res$inflation_effect
  data <- res$data

  inflation_df <- data.frame(
    labels = names(inflation_effect)[1:3],
    pre_correction = as.numeric(inflation_effect)[1:3],
    post_correction = as.numeric(inflation_effect)[4:6]
  )

  list(stats_df = data, inflation_df = inflation_df)
}

bacon_wrapper <- function(label, iqr_df, prefix = "") {
  stats_df <- get_stat_data(label, prefix = prefix)

  res_ls <- bacon_analyze(stats_df)
  inflation_df <- res_ls$inflation_df
  stats_df <- res_ls$stats_df

  stats_df <- stats_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(iqr_df, by = "CpG")

  stats_df <- add_iqr_fdr(stats_df, min_iqr = 2)

  save_name <- paste0(prefix, "EAP_stats_bacon_", label, ".csv")
  inflation_name <- paste0(prefix, "EAP_inflation_", label, ".csv")

  write.csv(
    inflation_df,
    file = file.path(save_dir, inflation_name),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    stats_df,
    file = file.path(save_dir, save_name),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

# Analyze

## Load Data

```{r load}
dnam_data <- get_dnam_data()
iqr_df <- get_iqr(dnam_data)
```

## Run Bacon Correction

```{r bacon}
bacon_wrapper("ptau", iqr_df)
bacon_wrapper("interact", iqr_df)
```

## Run Bacon Correction, Smoking Adjusted

```{r bacon_smoking}
bacon_wrapper("ptau", iqr_df, prefix = "Smoking_Adjusted_")
bacon_wrapper("interact", iqr_df, prefix = "Smoking_Adjusted_")
```
